name: Matt Doran
bio: Matt Doran was born on March 30, 1976 in Sydney, New South Wales, Australia as Matthew J. Doran. He is an actor and cinematographer.

credits.overview: A U.S. Army Captain uses her years of tactical training to save humanity from sixteen nuclear missiles launched at the U.S. as a violent attack threatens her remote missile interceptor station.

credits.title: Intersection
credits.overview: When a conman discovers his son is abducted, he is forced to drive the streets of Sydney completing an escalating series of trials to appease the kidnapper, and atone for his career of deception.
